newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up as investors await budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up as investors await budget.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 up at 41.82 to the dollar on Friday amid low demand for the U.S. currency before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget to be announced this evening.
"The rupee will remain volatile as market players will weigh the impact of the budget before taking new positions," one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 3.60 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
